title: Receipts split by total only; items track original and discounted price; totals must match

acceptance_criteria.outcome: A group receipt is split on its total by Equal (default), Exact or Shares; stored shares equal the amount exactly. Manual group expenses keep all split types.
Item assignments are gone from web, mobile and server; requests sending them are rejected with a clear update message.
Each line records original, discount and paid price; discounts are never subtracted again; coupons and whole-receipt discounts are folded into paid prices; no negative lines.
Paid lines plus tax plus tip must match the amount within 0.02 on every receipt save path; scanned tax and tip are kept.
Older item-split and old-discount-format receipts keep their saved money unless the user changes it, and nothing is discounted twice.
Returns and refund lines are flagged for review, and price history uses paid prices.
